title: Migrating the Microsoft Entra Connect Source Anchor to mS-DS-ConsistencyGuid for AD Domain Consolidation & Cross-Forest Migration (Quest On Demand Migration)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 — identity-critical migration enabler: switch the Entra Connect source anchor on an existing objectGUID deployment; precondition + permission checks; coordination with Quest ODM attribute stamping; high risk (breaks the AD↔Entra link if done wrong), effectively one-way.
Scoped to the GAP (source-anchor migration for domain consolidation) — does NOT re-teach general Entra Connect/hybrid-identity setup (that's the companion Hybrid Identity product).
Quest ODM console internals deferred to Quest docs.
